# Climate profile (`climate-profile` v1)

A counterparty's emissions, targets and transition and physical risk scores.

**Group:** Climate · **Mnemonic:** `CLIM` · **Identifiers:** `CLIM-…` in `profileId`

Open one with `CLIM <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: climate-profile
version: 1
description: "A counterparty's emissions, targets and transition and physical risk scores."
match: { kind: climate-profile, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Climate · Climate profile, id: $.profileId }
strip:
  - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterpartyName }
  - { label: Sector, bind: $.sector }
  - { label: "Scope 1+2 (tCO2e)", bind: $.scope12, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Intensity, bind: $.intensity, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Transition risk, bind: $.transitionScore, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Physical risk, bind: $.physicalScore, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Net-zero target, bind: $.netZeroTarget }
panels:
  - id: scopes
    kind: hbar
    title: Emissions by scope (tCO2e)
    code: EMIS
    key: F2
    rows: $.scopes
    label: scope
    value: tco2e
    fmt: amount0
  - id: trend
    kind: line
    title: "Scope 1+2 emissions by year"
    area: right
    rows: $.history
    x: year
    y: tco2e
    fmt: compact
  - id: targets
    kind: kv
    title: Targets and disclosure
    key: F3
    rows: $.targets
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.counterparty, 'counterparty')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
